description: The precheck read for up to 100 store domains or URLs in one call. Returns one precheck object per input, in order, each with an input field, plus routes[]: the best known ways in for an agent (ucp, ucp_mcp, storefront_mcp, cart_link, browser), best evidence first, each with checked_at, age_hours and stale. Saved checks only. Does not fetch any store and does not start a scan. Each domain counts as one read against the same limit as precheck (60 a minute per network); domains past the limit come back with reason rate_limited and retry_after_seconds. More than 100 domains is refused. not_recorded and known:false are not a no. JSON: POST /api/precheck/bulk with {"domains": [...]}. Advisory only. ARC stops before payment. Data CC BY 4.0, attribute ARC (arcreport.ai).

domains.description: 1 to 100 store domains or URLs, such as allbirds.com or https://allbirds.com/products/shoe.
